question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Lavish
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (4) **i.e. **'Luxurious'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lavish (ढेर सारा)** - Sumptuously rich, elaborate, or luxurious.

 
 
• **Example:** They hosted a lavish party to celebrate their wedding anniversary.
 
 
 
• **Luxurious (ऐश्वर्यपूर्ण)** - Extremely comfortable or elegant, and involving great expense.
 
 
• **Example:** They stayed in a luxurious hotel during their vacation.
 
 
 
• Hence, 'Luxurious' is the synonym of the given word 'Lavish'.

Therefore, the correct answer is 'Luxurious'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Unique (अद्वितीय) **- Being the only one of its kind; distinct.

 
 
• **Example: **Her approach to solving problems is unique.
 
 
 
• **Stylish (शानदार) **- Fashionably elegant and sophisticated.
 
 
• **Example: **He is known for his stylish appearance at every social event.
 
 
 
• **Meagre (अल्प)** - Lacking in quantity or quality.
 
 
• **Example:** The meagre resources weren't enough to complete the project on time.
 
 

64:T66c,

The correct answer is Option (4)</str
